title: Zoning text change for housing at 108-05 68th Road, Forest Hills
summary: This resolution approves, with modifications, a zoning text amendment designating a Mandatory Inclusionary Housing area at 108-05 68th Road in Forest Hills, Queens. It would help enable a seven-story mixed-use building with about 33 apartments, including eight income-restricted units, plus 11,500 square feet of community facility space. It is linked to a related zoning map amendment changing the site from an R1-2A to an R7A district.
